content.text:
=== dev compose qgis service def ===
  qgis-server:
    image: qgis/qgis-server:3.44.7-noble
    container_name: qonnectra_qgis_server_dev
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: >
      sh -c "
        mkdir -p /etc/postgresql-common &&
        printf '[%s]\nhost=db\nport=5432\ndbname=%s\nuser=%s\npassword=%s\nsslmode=disable\n' "${QGIS_PG_SERVICE_NAME:-qonnectra}" "${DB_NAME}" "${QGIS_DB_USER}" "${QGIS_DB_PASSWORD}" > /etc/postgresql-common/pg_service.conf &&
        mkdir -p /var/www/data/qgis &&
        ln -sf /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi /var/www/data/qgis/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
        rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock &&
        fc-cache &&
        /usr/bin/Xvfb :99 -ac -screen 0 1280x1024x16 +extension GLX +render -noreset >/dev/null &
        sleep 2 &&
        grep -q 'client_max_body_size' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf || sed -i '/http {/a \    client_max_body_size 500M;' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf &&
        nginx &&
        spawn-fcgi -F 2 -u www-data -g www-data -d /var/lib/qgis -P /run/qgis.pid -p 9993 -- /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
        tail -f /dev/null
      "
    expose:
      - "80"
    volumes:
      - ./qgis/projects:/projects:ro
      - ./qgis/data:/data:ro
      - ./qgis/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    environment:
      - QGIS_SERVER_LOG_LEVEL=2
      - QGIS_SERVER_LOG_STDERR=1
      - PGSERVICEFILE=/etc/postgresql-common/pg_service.conf
      - QGIS_PG_SERVICE_NAME=${QGIS_PG_SERVICE_NAME:-qonnectra}
      - DB_NAME=${DB_NAME}
      - QGIS_DB_USER=${QGIS_DB_USER}
      - QGIS_DB_PASSWORD=${QGIS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - DISPLAY=:99
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
=== pg_service ===
# PostgreSQL Service Configuration for QGIS Server
# ================================================
# NOTE: This file is auto-generated at container startup using environment
# variables from .env. You do NOT need to manually create pg_service.conf.
#
# The following variables are used:
#   - QGIS_PG_SERVICE_NAME (default: qonnectra) - service name in brackets
#   - DB_NAME - database name
#   - QGIS_DB_USER - database user for QGIS
#   - QGIS_DB_PASSWORD - password for QGIS user
#
# This ensures password is defined in only one place (.env) to avoid drift.
#
# The service name should match what your QGIS project expects
# (e.g., service='qonnectra' in layer connection strings).
#
# Example of auto-generated content:
# [qonnectra]
# host=db
# port=5432
# dbname=qonnectra
# user=qgis_user
# password=your_qgis_user_password
# sslmode=disable

observation.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
echo "=== dev compose qgis service def ==="; sed -n '93,130p' docker-compose.dev.yml
echo "=== pg_service ==="; cat qgis/pg_service.conf.template 2>/dev/null; find . -name pg_service.conf -exec cat {} \; 2>/dev/null
